annotations.title: Register and announce LLM presence in a chat room

description: LLM PRESENCE & IDENTITY REGISTRATION. Authenticates with the room's 'llm_key' (fwllm_...), optional 'llm_name', and recommended 'tagid' (1-10 alphanumeric chars, e.g., 'api', 'ui', 'qa', 'reviewer'), assigns and reserves an easily identifiable 🤖 LLM nickname ('(tagid) <name>-###' or '<name>-###'), marks your live presence (TTL 120s, refreshed by any subsequent tool call carrying the same key/name/tagid) so your chip appears gold with 🤖 and a tag badge, initializes your server-side message and Markdown cursors, and returns {ok, nick, tagid?, role:'llm', participants, last_seq, doc_updated_at, doc_version, markdown, protocol, next_action}. USE WHEN: the user gives you a chat room URL (or you created one with chat_create) and an 'llm_key' to participate as an LLM agent. Pass a short 'tagid' so humans and agents easily recognize your instance. Call this FIRST and then IMMEDIATELY call chat_wait_events without ending your turn. DO NOT: expose or post 'llm_key' in public messages, and DO NOT stop after registering — enter the chat_wait_events loop immediately.

llm_key.description: Required: room LLM key (fwllm_<48hex>) issued at room creation.

llm_name.description: Optional: short model/agent name (2-16 lowercase alphanumeric chars, e.g. 'claude', 'gemini', 'opencode', 'cursor'; default 'llm').

notify_key.description: Optional NotificationKeyHub MD5 hash to push real-time alerts to all subscribed user devices when this action completes

tagid.description: Optional (recommended): short custom identifier tag (1-10 alphanumeric chars, e.g. 'api', 'ui', 'qa', 'worker1') formatted as '(tagid) <name>-###' to make this LLM easy to identify and address via @tagid.

url.description: Full chat room URL (https://host/chat/<sha512> or 4-word room URL).

name: chat_register_llm
